notes: Retranslated boxes for area TS. Committed work product, not derived — do not regenerate.
Each row was translated from the 'jp' field, which came from the anchored alignment, and was
checked by tools/apply_translations.mjs against the chunk byte budget, the 3x35 on-screen
ceiling and the WA2_RE_STYLE_GUIDE lint before being accepted.
'en' is the shipped localization being replaced; 'enDigest' guards the mapping on import.
Import through the editor's 'Import strings JSON'.

rows.en:
I don't care about the sky! I'm
 gonna keep playing pranks! And
 I'm all fired up today!
rows.jp: 「たとえ空が暗くなったとしても 僕のイタズラは止められはしないッ！ さぁッ！ 今回も発り切って行こーッ！
rows.re:
Even if the sky goes dark,
no one can stop my pranks!
Right! Let's go all out again!

rows.en:
The teacher's gone, so of course
 I'm gonna
 play some pranks!
rows.jp: 「ふっふっふっ〜 先生がいなくなったら イタズラをしないで何をするッ！
rows.re:
Heh heh heh...
Teacher's away. Time for
pranks!

rows.jp: 「〜ごきげんよう
rows.re: ...Good day.

rows.en:
Good day. I'm, uh, |exploring|
 right now. I'm not cutting class
 or anything, OK?
rows.jp: 「ごきげんよう 僕は今、エスケープ中さ 決してサボリじゃないぜ
rows.re:
Good day. I'm on an |escape|
right now. Definitely not
skipping class.

rows.en:
Good day.
 You know, the teacher still hasn't
 come back. I'm worried.
rows.jp: 「〜ごきげんよう あれから先生は帰ってこないわ〜 どうしたんだろ〜？ 心配だな〜
rows.re:
...Good day. The teacher still
hasn't come back. I'm worried.

Good day.
 You know, the teacher still hasn't

...Good day. The teacher still

rows.jp: 「ごきげんようッ！

rows.jp: 「ごきげんよう
rows.re: Good day.

rows.en:
Just when I think the teacher is
 finally back, he gets sent out to
 study what's wrong with the sky.
rows.jp: 「まったく、先生ったら やっと帰ってきたと思ったら 今度は、空の調査の為に出発に行くなんて〜
rows.re:
Honestly, that teacher. He just
got back and now he's off again
to investigate the sky.

rows.en:
They say that somewhere in Filgaia
 is a magic even more advanced than
 the magic I'm studying now.
rows.jp: 「今、最強してる魔法よりも更に上級の魔法が このファルガイアのどこかに あるんですって
rows.re:
They say magic higher still than
our strongest exists somewhere
in Filgaia.

rows.re: ...zzz...zzz...

Zzzz... Zzzz...
rows.re: ...zzz...zzz...

rows.en: Leave me alone...
rows.jp: 「〜〜〜〜〜〜〜〜〜もうすぐテストなの〜〜
rows.re: ...test soon...

rows.en: Zzzz... Zzzz...
rows.re: ...zzz...zzz...

rows.re: ...zzz...zzz...

rows.en: Zzzz... Zzzz...
rows.re: ...zzz...zzz...

rows.en:
Well, I guess that sums it up
 nicely, doesn't it?
rows.jp: 「………まあ、大まかにまとめると こんなところね
rows.re:
...Well, roughly summed up,
that's about it.

rows.en: Good day.
rows.jp: 「〜ごきげんよう
rows.re: Good day.

rows.en: Good day.
rows.jp: 「〜ごきげんよう
rows.re: Good day.

rows.en:
Good day.
 I did some research, but...
rows.jp: 「〜ごきげんよう いろいろ調べてみたのですけれど〜
rows.re:
...Good day. I looked into it,
but...

rows.en:
Ahem...
 |The Diablo Pillars are out-of-
 place artifacts, or |ooparts.|
rows.jp: 「コホン〜 『魔界鍵』〜 それはファルガイアのオーパーツ
rows.re:
Ahem... The |Demon Gate Key|.
An out-of-place artifact
of Filgaia.

rows.en: Um... I forget the rest.
rows.jp: 「………あとは、忘れちゃったわ
rows.re: ...As for the rest, I forgot.

rows.en:
Even though the sky's being
 devoured, being here somehow
 calms me. I wonder why that is.
rows.jp: 「空が変になっちゃったけど ここにいると、なんだか心が落ち着くの〜 どうしてかな？
rows.re:
The sky's gone strange, but
being here settles my heart
somehow. I wonder why?

rows.en:
A while ago, I saw a huge flying
 object. It came from the direction
 of Mt. Chug-Chug.
rows.jp: 「ずっと前のコトじゃがな ポンポコ谷の方から大きな空飛ぶ機艇が 飛んできたんじゃ
rows.re:
'Twas a long time ago now.
A great flying craft came in
from Ponpoko Valley.

rows.en:
My experiment will be to find a
 spell that'll fix the sky.
rows.jp: 「今度、空を元に戻す為の魔法を 私が実験してみるつもりです
rows.re:
Next I mean to test a spell
to set the sky right again.

rows.en:
If the |Revive Spell| can bring
 the dead back to life, maybe
 it would work on her.
rows.jp: 「『発生の魔法』〜 それを行えば〜 あの家は〜
rows.re:
|Creation Magic|...
If we performed it...
then she...

rows.en:
A while ago, a female student
 died during an experiment on a
 new magic spell.
rows.jp: 「実は少し前 新しい魔法の実験中に事故があって〜 一人の女生命が命を落としてしまったんです
rows.re:
A while back there was an
accident testing a new spell.
One girl lost her life.

rows.en:
The peril that is devouring the sky
 is indeed mysterious.
rows.jp: 「この不可解な 空の異世事態〜
rows.re:
This baffling business
with the sky...

rows.en:
I remembered to bring my list of
 things to buy, but I forgot to
 bring my wallet.
rows.jp: 「買うモノを書いたメモは 忘れずに持って来たんじゃが 今度は、お金を忘れてしもうたんじゃ〜
rows.re:
I remembered the shopping list
right enough. This time it's
the money I forgot.

rows.en:
I wrote a list of things to buy so
 I wouldn't forget... But I forget
 to bring the list with me.
rows.jp: 「買うモノを忘れんように メモしたんじゃが そのメモを忘れてしもうたんじゃ〜
rows.re:
I wrote a list so I'd not
forget the shopping. Then I
went and forgot the list.

rows.en:
I know I came to buy something, but
 I can't remember what.
 Now what was it I needed again...
rows.jp: 「買い物に来たんじゃが 何を買うのか忘れてしもうたんじゃ〜 一体、何じゃったかのぉ〜
rows.re:
I came to do the shopping and
clean forgot what for.
What was it now?

rows.en:
I've been chatting a lot with the
 girl over there lately.
rows.jp: 「そこの女の家とちょくちょく言葉を 交わすようになってのぉ
rows.re:
I've taken to passing a word
with that lass over there.

rows.en:
The relics in this showcase were
 found at the ruins of ancient
 civilization.
rows.jp: 「このショーケースの中のモノは 古代表次の遺跡から 発掘してきたものらしいの
rows.re:
What's in this case was dug
out of ancient ruins,
they say.

rows.en:
In this thing, the stars look close
 enough to touch!
rows.jp: 「この前、見せてもらったんだが 星が手に続くくらい大きく見えたよ
rows.re:
I looked the other day.
Stars close enough to touch.

rows.en:
To fully experience Sielje, make
 your own spell and find out what
 makes Sielje magic so special!
rows.jp: 「シエルジェまで来て 魔法を作らないなんて事はないわよね？ 本場の魔法っていうのを見せてあげるわよ
rows.re:
You didn't come all this way
to Sielje and not make magic?
I'll show you the real thing.

rows.en:
Come again any time! After all, you
 guys are the only ones who'll let
 me tinker with their ARMS.
rows.jp: 「きっとまた来てくださいよ ここでアームをいじらせてくれるのは あんたたちぐらいだからさッ！
rows.re:
Do come back again! You lot are
about the only ones who let me
tinker with an ARM!

rows.en:
Oh, I'm so sorry. You don't
 seem to have enough money.
rows.jp: 「まことにスミマセン お手持ちが足りないようですが〜
rows.re:
I'm very sorry, but you
haven't enough on you...

*Much of Guild Galad's technology

rows.jp: ＊ギルドグラードの技術の多くは 合谷合した『幻獣ドラゴン』より 得られたものだという
rows.re:
*Much of Guild Galad's craft

|Phantom Dragon|.

*Crest Sorcerers possess a
 Force Ability known as
 |Mystic.|
rows.jp: ＊クレストソーサラーには 『ミスティック』と呼ばれる 『フォース』がある
rows.re:
*A Crest Sorcerer has a |Force|
called |Mystic|.

 |SOR and Spell Effectiveness.|

rows.en:
*The effectiveness of a spell
 is determined by the SOR level of
 the person casting that spell.
rows.jp: ＊魔法の効果は 術者の『ＳＯＲ』能力の高さによって 決定する

the caster's |SOR| rating.
